title: Nostalgic Korean Lamb Kebabs
description: A cultured and cheese-pull nostalgic Korean dish featuring lamb kidney, served with a sweet and spicy glaze, perfect for a low-glycemic friendly meal, cooked on a raclette-grill.
instructions: Preheat the raclette-grill to medium-high heat.
In a large bowl, whisk together gochujang, soy sauce, brown sugar, garlic, and ginger.
Add the lamb kidney cubes to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the marinated lamb kidney cubes onto skewers.
Brush the sesame oil onto the grill and cook the lamb kebabs for 5 minutes per side.
While the lamb is cooking, melt the mozzarella cheese on the raclette-grill.
Serve the lamb kebabs with the melted cheese, green onions, and a side of low-glycemic friendly vegetables.
Garnish with additional green onions and serve immediately.
